summary: Sidney Emmert of Oklahoma City was killed when a 1941 Stearman biplane crashed near Wetmore and ignited a blaze that burned 155 acres of forest land; passenger Dr. Robert Hamilton of Wetmore escaped with minor injuries after attempting to save the pilot's life; most of the fire burned on U.S. Forest Service land.
notes: Aviation fatality; date pinned to 2011-07-03 (Sunday-verified) by the late-July-2011 Colorado Central Magazine regional roundup, which cites the Wet Mountain Tribune. Filed per the aviation-fatality precedent (ids 2307/1031/3044); SAR-team response not documented in source found.
